verdict.rationale: Warp's own docs cover visual theming, and they explicitly say themes can sync with the OS light/dark mode. They also document auto-generating themes from a background image. missing for 10: details on how color schemes are configured or imported (e.g., custom theme files), how the light/dark switching is set up, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can apply color schemes and themes, including automatic light/dark mode switching

citations.quote: Warp supports synchronizing your theme with the OS’s light and dark themes.
Customize Warp's visual appearance, including themes, fonts, prompts, app icons, input position, and pane behavior.
Automatically create new themes based on a background image.
